text_block_list.text: Today is the day of the 'Little Horse Girls Footrace Tournament,' a community exchange event. Amidst the watchful eyes of academy staff and parents—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Let us go, my little sister!
A deafeningly loud voice boomed from right next to me. Startled, I turned to look...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Unleash your fastest, strongest, full-bakushin power right here, right now!

text_block_list.name: Bakushin O's Younger Sister
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Big sis! I'll do my very best!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Oh? Trainer-san over there! Could it be that your eyes are already locked onto my dear sister!?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: What extraordinary discernment! Today is the day my sister makes her grand, high-flying bakushin debut! Please keep your eyes glued to her!

text_block_list.name: Bakushin O's Younger Sister
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Trainer-san! Nice to meet you today!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: My sister is the absolute strongest! Her grades in elementary school are outstanding! Her cooking is top-tier, and in today's race, she will undoubtedly leave behind a legendary... Huh!?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: If that happens... scout offers for class president will come pouring in! My sister will! Finally! Become the class president!!

text_block_list.name: Bakushin O's Little Sister
text_block_list.text:
Um, I don't really care about being class rep...
But I'll do my best in the race! I'm gonna
Bakushin just like you, Big Sis!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Bwahahaha! Precisely!
If you run just like me, 1st place is guaranteed!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
It's all about Bakushin!
Keep on Bakushin-ing, and the finish line will be
here in the blink of an eye!

text_block_list.name: Bakushin O & Sister
text_block_list.text: Let's Bakushiiin!

Before long, the race got underway.
Watching closely to see how her promising little sister would run...

text_block_list.name: Bakushin O's Little Sister
text_block_list.text:
*pant*...! *gasp*!
I gotta Bakushin... Bakushin even harder!

text_block_list.name: Bakushin O's Little Sister
text_block_list.text:
*pant*, *gasp*...! Te... 10th place...
—I-I'm sorry, Big Sis... I couldn't do it... like you...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Ba... ba-ba-ba, ba—
choice_data_list: It was unfortunate, but next time for sure—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Bakushin-level inspiring!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
*waaaah*! My little sister, who was once so tiny,
sprinting across the turf with such magnificent splendor!
This truly is the miracle known as the mystery of growth!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Dignified, robust, and an extraordinary run! The pounding in my chest is nothing short of
Bakushin-level inspiration! Pure thrill! A grand deluge of moved tears!

text_block_list.name: Bakushin O's Little Sister
text_block_list.text:
B-But, I got 10th place...
I was completely terrible...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
10th place! Isn't that a splendid result?!
The sight of you giving it your absolute all was truly exemplary!
The world is erupting with excitement—it's pure Bakushin fever!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Even more so than the Supreme Class Representative Prime Minister...
it was a Bakushin worthy of the most wonderful class president! Yes, indeed!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry, you'll definitely win the next one!
Because your Bakushin was more wonderful! More beautiful! And faster than anyone else's!

text_block_list.name: Bakushin O's Little Sister
text_block_list.text:
A-Ahaha... Is that so?
Um... thank you, Big Sis.

text_block_list.name: Bakushin O's Little Sister
text_block_list.text:
But...
I still wanted to run cool, just like you, Big Sis...

Encouraged by Sakura Bakushin O, her little sister nevertheless dropped her shoulders
and trudged away dejectedly.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Chowa?! C-C-Could it be...?! She is feeling down?! But why?!
choice_data_list: Let's leave her be for now.
Maybe we should leave her alone for a bit.
How about giving her some special training?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Chowa?! C-C-Could it be...?! She is feeling down?! But why?!
choice_data_list: Let's leave her be for now.
Maybe we should leave her alone for a bit.
How about giving her some special training?!

text_block_list.text:
Sakura Bakushin O might not fully understand
the pain that girl is currently feeling.
Giving her some space for now is probably what's needed.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Leave her be?!
Th-That... does that mean we shouldn't Bakushin?!
choice_data_list: Watching over her is also a form of Bakushin!
Quietly watching over her is Bakushin too!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
What did you say?!
Bakushin... is truly profound, isn't it?!
The two of them quietly watched the little sister's receding figure.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I see! When you're feeling down, that's when you Bakushin the hardest!
Indeed, every single hardship, sorrow, and tragedy can all be resolved with Bakushin!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Little Sister! We're running all the way home!!
Allow this hot-blooded Bakushin coach to whip you into shape!

text_block_list.name: Bakushin O's Little Sister
text_block_list.text:
Big Sis... Yeah, you're right.
Moping around isn't gonna help anything!

text_block_list.name: Bakushin O & Sister
text_block_list.text: Toward the sun, BAKUSHIIIN!!
